attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole notice is two sentences: his memory is recorded in Delehaye's synaxarion with the note that he practised asceticism on Olympus of Bithynia, and he is «ο Ιωάννη τον μοναχό (919 - 944 μ.Χ.) που υπήρξε γνωστός για την αγιότητα της ζωής του επί Ρωμανού του Λεκαπηνού» — the monk John, 919 to 944, known for the holiness of his life in the days of Romanos Lekapenos, to whom that emperor, after his fall, sent a sealed letter confessing his sins. **No `dates` proposed**: the 919–944 the page prints beside his name is the reign of Romanos Lekapenos and not years of his life — the reign is exactly that span — and this corpus refuses a reign-hung year, on the `carterius-of-caesarea` precedent; the reign is in the life instead. No `locations`, the folder being undated, though Olympus of Bithynia is named in the prose. No hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
